type.title: What heats your home?
type.description: Pick the closest match. The next steps only ask what this setup needs.

data_description.heating_type: Not sure? A hot water tank in a cupboard means the first option. Hot water straight from the boiler, no tank, means combi.

boiler.title: Your boiler
boiler.description: How Home Assistant turns the heating on. Both are optional: leave empty if only your TRVs are smart.

data_description.boiler_switch: The relay, smart switch or thermostat that calls the boiler for heating.
data_description.boiler_on_sensor: On while the boiler actually burns. Makes learning and gas figures more accurate.

thermostat.title: Your thermostat
thermostat.description: How Smart Heating should drive it.

data_description.thermostat_style: Setpoint is recommended: if Home Assistant stops, the thermostat keeps the last sensible temperature.

data_description.hot_water_system: Tank: a cylinder in a cupboard (also known as S-plan or Y-plan). Combi: hot water straight from the boiler.
data_description.hw_calling: On while the tank is heating, e.g. its zone valve or programmer channel.
data_description.hot_water_priority: Pause room heating while the tank heats, so showers are ready sooner. Combi boilers do this by themselves.

outside.title: Outside temperature
outside.description: Used to skip heating on mild days, predict tonight and learn how your house holds heat. One of the two is enough.

data_description.outdoor_temperature: A real outdoor sensor, if you have one. Blended with the forecast.

extras.title: Optional extras
extras.description: All optional. You can add them later in Reconfigure.

data_description.alarm_panel: Alarm armed away, everyone out, or a toggle. Away = heating off, frost protection only.
data_description.night_schedule: A schedule helper. Empty = 22:00 to 07:00, changeable in Configure.
data_description.gas_meter: Cumulative meter in kWh or m³. Empty = estimated from boiler runtime.

rooms.title: Rooms
rooms.description:
Each Home Assistant area becomes a room, with its thermometer, TRVs or heaters, presence sensors and lights filled in. {count} area(s) found. You can add, remove or adjust rooms any time.

After this, Smart Heating learns your house for 1 to 3 days. It only watches until then.

data_description.areas: Untick areas you don't want heated. Gardens are skipped.

abort.already_configured: Smart Heating is already set up.

import_areas.title: Import Rooms From Areas
import_areas.description: Each selected area becomes a room, with its floor, sensors, TRVs, presence sensors and lights picked up automatically. {count} new area(s) are pre-selected; if all areas are already rooms, those are selected instead. Turn on the re-detect option to fix rooms whose thermometer was picked wrongly.

data.refresh_sensors: Re-detect thermometer and humidity sensor for rooms already added

data_description.areas: Each area becomes a room. Gardens are skipped.
data_description.refresh_sensors: Re-pick thermometer and humidity for rooms already added. Other settings kept.

data_description.baseline_day: Empty rooms never drop below this by day.
data_description.baseline_night: Empty rooms never drop below this at night.
data_description.safety: Frost and damp floor. Always on, even when Off or away.
data_description.season_gate: Outdoor day mean above this = no comfort heating.
data_description.override_hours: How long Heat now / Turn off lasts.

data_description.boiler_input_kw: Boiler gas input. Used only without a gas meter.

data_description.hysteresis: Heat starts this far below target. Bigger = fewer burns.
data_description.coast_rate: Rising this fast without heat = wait, don't fire.
data_description.coast_horizon_min: Wait only if target is reached within this time.
data_description.stack_max_wait_min: Longest an upper room waits for heat rising from below.
data_description.trv_open_offset: Open TRV = target plus this. Caps the room if HA stops.
data_description.hw_max_pause_min: Longest heating pauses for hot water.
data_description.notify_service: Phone notification when calibration finishes, e.g. notify.mobile_app_phone.
data_description.skip_calibration: Start control without waiting for calibration (usually 1 to 3 days). Defaults are used until learning catches up in the background.

user.title: Add room
user.description: Pick the Home Assistant area. Name and floor come from the area.

data_description.area_id: Name and floor come from the area.

data_description.floor: Only asked when the area has no floor.
data_description.priority: A living and sleeping. B occasional. C halls and service.
data_description.comfort: Target while the room is in use.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Head-height thermometer, away from the radiator. Not the TRV.
data_description.trvs: Smart radiator valves. Empty = radiator not controlled.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion. Marks the room in use.
data_description.lights: Light on = room in use, for 30 min max without presence.
data_description.schedule: On = room wanted warm, e.g. bedroom evenings.
data_description.heaters: Smart plugs or smart heaters Smart Heating switches on and off.
data_description.heater_power_w: Full power from the label, e.g. 2000 W. Not needed if the plug measures power.
data_description.heater_eco_power_w: Optional. Used when a smart heater reports eco mode, e.g. 1000 W.
data_description.radiator: Off if this room has only electric heat.

details.title: {area}
details.description:
Floor: {floor}. What we found in this area is filled in; adjust if needed.

Thermometer candidates: {detected}.

data_description.floor: Only asked when the area has no floor.
data_description.priority: A living and sleeping. B occasional. C halls and service.
data_description.comfort: Target while the room is in use.
data_description.temperature_sensor: Head-height thermometer, away from the radiator. Not the TRV.
data_description.trvs: Smart radiator valves. Empty = radiator not controlled.
data_description.presence: Presence or motion. Marks the room in use.
data_description.lights: Light on = room in use, for 30 min max without presence.
data_description.schedule: On = room wanted warm, e.g. bedroom evenings.
data_description.heaters: Smart plugs or smart heaters Smart Heating switches on and off.
data_description.heater_power_w: Full power from the label, e.g. 2000 W. Not needed if the plug measures power.
data_description.heater_eco_power_w: Optional. Used when a smart heater reports eco mode, e.g. 1000 W.
data_description.radiator: Off if this room has only electric heat.

error.no_temperature: Pick a temperature sensor or at least one TRV, so the room has a temperature to work with.
error.already_added: This area is already a room.

options.setpoint: Setpoint: it gets the target temperature
options.relay: On / off: heat at maximum or off

options.boiler_tank: Boiler with a hot water tank

heat_test.name: Heat test
heat_test.description: Speeds up calibration: opens every radiator and runs the boiler for about 2 h, then lets the house cool. Pause your own heating schedule first.

start.name: Start
start.description: On starts the test, off stops it early.

ignore_automations.name: Ignore other automations
ignore_automations.description: Run even if other enabled automations use the boiler control.

start_control.name: Start control
start_control.description: Turns Monitor only off so Smart Heating drives the boiler and TRVs.

skip_calibration.name: Skip calibration
skip_calibration.description: Start before calibration ends, with default settings. Learning continues in the background.
